warnings.title: Some proposed packed product sizes are incomplete
warnings.detail: Shopify requires all four packed product size fields together, or all four blank. Partial values can reject the affected product. Review the listed proposed source lines and omitted fields.

warnings.title: Requires shipping is false: saved packed product size can be cleared
warnings.detail: Shopify clears saved packed size when Requires shipping is false, even when the four packed size columns are omitted. Any included size values are ignored. These findings do not prove a saved size exists in the store; confirm the intended result before importing.

notes: Packed size checks cover partial proposed values and Requires shipping=false using current header names only. Units, numeric validity, shipping aliases, all-blank size clearing and the complete import schema are not validated.
This compares files locally; it does not connect to Shopify or upload either file.
Column names are normalized for comparison. Shopify requires exact template headers, including case; verify both files against the current Shopify CSV format.
A report is a review aid, not a guarantee that an import is safe. Verify against Shopify's current documentation and your import settings.
